Gas Release Causes Smoke Plume, Evacuations at California Landfill

A release of gas at the Chiquita Canyon landfill in Castaic, California, caused a large plume of smoke to billow into the air. The Los Angeles county fire department reported the incident, stating that workers hit a deposit of gas during routine digging in an area that had not been worked on recently. The event prompted an evacuation alert, and six people were taken to the hospital.
